that which has been allocated, allotted

to spam, to constantly bombard with electronic messages
to be busy, to have work to do

not shy or suspicious: friendly, trustful

zutraulich.et: From zutrauen + -lich. The verb is used here in the archaic sense of “to trust” (German vertrauen). Compare vertraulich, which however has a somewhat different sense.

s: Proverb expressing that fear of something is often worse than the thing itself
zu Tode gefürchtet ist auch gestorben.et: Literally, “fearing to death is dying as well”. Ascribed to Johann Nestroy.
